speaker: Old Wanderer
text: The village well has run dry. Will you look for the spring?

speaker: Old Wanderer
text: Follow the path east. I'll wait here.

speaker: Old Wanderer
text: No matter. The offer stands, should you change your mind.

speaker: Old Wanderer
text: You came through! The village won't forget this.

speaker: Old Wanderer
text: A spring, out here? I wouldn't know where to start looking.
